title: InternVL: Scaling up Vision Foundation Models and Aligning for Generic Visual-Linguistic Tasks
grouping: Three panels in a row, captioned (a) supervised pre-training, (b) contrastive pre-training and (c) the paper's approach, each panel as wide as its number of encoders (one, two, three). No frames or separators; the captions alone define the panels. In each, inputs are words at the bottom ('image', 'text', 'prompt'), each encoder is a trapezoid above its input, and the objective word ('classes', 'contrastive', 'generative') sits at the top, reached by straight or arched arrows.
shapes_depth: Every model is the same white trapezoid, wide at the bottom and narrow at the top, with a thin grey outline and a faint drop shadow; model names are centred inside in plain sans. Thin black arrows; contrastive pairing is an arch of two curved arrows meeting at the objective word, and a long arch in (c) links the vision encoder to the far right model. A thick grey double-headed arrow labelled 'shared weights' sits between the two language-model trapezoids.
proposed_highlight: Only the 'ours' panel (c) has a third trapezoid, a longer arch, and the single coloured mark in the figure: inside its vision encoder, the claim 'to 6B #params' in bold with '6B' in red. The caption ends with '(ours)'.
lesson: Contrast pre-training paradigms with identical blank trapezoids and arched arrows to one objective word each, letting the 'ours' panel differ only by an extra trapezoid and one red-bold number written inside its encoder.
notes: Venue: the arXiv comment and PDF give none (remembered as CVPR 2024, unverified); year = arXiv preprint year. The shadowed trapezoids are embedded raster images in the PDF, so `kb measure` counts them as photo (photo_share 0.579); the measured palette covers only the remaining line art.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
